fullPassage: In consultative selling, one acts as a consultant offering solutions to clients for their problems rather than simply trying to push products or services. As a result, forging personal relationships based on trust and a natural rapport is key, and one skill important for this task is establishing appropriate eye contact. Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust needed in consultative sales. Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, listening to the others’ concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing them. However, as with all forms of nonverbal communication, one must always take cues from others to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes. Prolonged, unbroken stares can make people uncomfortable and even be considered rude in some cultures.

det.korean: '상대에게서 단서를 얻다'는, 상대의 비언어적 반응을 읽고 그에 맞춰 눈맞춤 정도를 조절하라는 뜻이에요.
det.analysis:
밑줄 뒤 'to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes(눈을 마주칠 때 실수를 피하려고)'가 결정적 단서예요.

② 오래 응시하라는 뜻이 아니라 오히려 지나친 응시는 역효과예요

③ 질문을 많이 던지라는 말이 아니에요

④ 상대 말을 따라 하라는 뜻이 아니에요

questions.passage: In consultative selling, one acts as a consultant offering solutions to clients for their problems rather than simply trying to push products or services. As a result, forging personal relationships based on trust and a natural rapport is key, and one skill important for this task is establishing appropriate eye contact. Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust needed in consultative sales. Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, listening to the others’ concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing <u>them</u>. However, as with all forms of nonverbal communication, one must always take cues from others to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes. Prolonged, unbroken stares can make people uncomfortable and even be considered rude in some cultures.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 them은 앞에 나온 '상대의 고민(the others' concerns)'을 가리켜요.
det.analysis:
밑줄 앞 'listening to the others' concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing them(상대의 고민을 경청하고 그것을 해결하는 데 도움을 주고자)'이 단서예요.

① 상담가들 — 도움을 주는 주체라 '해결 대상'이 아니에요

② 상대의 고민(걱정) — 해결(fixing)의 대상이라 them이 가리키는 것이에요 ←정답

③ 제품과 서비스 — 앞 문장에서 멀고 해결 대상이 아니에요

④ 다양한 문화들 — 마지막 문장의 다른 대상이에요
det.tip: fixing them → the others' concerns(상대의 고민).

det.korean: financial negotiation=금전 협상 / verbal persuasion=언어적 설득 / nonverbal communication=비언어적 의사소통 / written contracts=서면 계약
